profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
Accomplished firmware developer with extensive experience in HW and IO debug.  Proven record of leadership and mentoring by leading multiple teams through product development life cycles.
Nguyen, Tung.  2020.  Detecting silent data corruption for mass storage devices.  U.S Patent 10877842 filed September 8, 2017 and issued December 29, 2020.

Specialties: ARM, Firmware, Storage, NVMe, PCIe, Debug, USB 2.0 USB 3.0 (EHCI/xHCI), C, C++, Linux device drivers, SystemVerilog, MIPI MPHY

positions.title: Firmware micro Architect
positions.description:
•	Lead Scrum team through firmware product development life cycle for SSDs and memory modules based on Intel’s Optane technology and ARM SoC.
•	Focus area in boot flow, resets handling and PCIe interface and debuggability.
•	Mentor team in adopting industry best practices and architectural vision during development and validation.
•	Other responsibilities include performing cost analysis on new feature, breakdown product requirements for team to consume, identifying areas of complexity for refactor and firmware development/debug.

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop features for next gen NVMe SSD based on Intel's Optane technology. 
•	Responsible for design and development of core firmware functionalities such as media management, firmware persistence context data management and power loss handling and performance/latency analysis.
•	Brought up firmware on various platforms such as Synopsys Virtual Platform, FPGA and ASIC. 
•	Debugged using combination of tools such as Greenhills JTAG, oscilloscope, logic analyzer and protocol analyzers as well as instrumenting FW with debug hooks to root-cause many complex issues throughout the development cycle. 
•	Continuously works with HW design team to add HW debug hooks to facilitate FW development, characterization, and debug.

positions.title: Validation Architect
positions.description:
•	Responsible for steering organization's validation strategy, tools, and methodology for USB Controller/IO and PCIe I/O. 
•	Pioneered a Hybrid FPGA platform for USB controller validation where the peripheral test device is implemented using C++ while connected to a host controller synthesized on the Synopsys HAPS FPGA UMR bus. This allowed us to cut cost on design/fabrication of the test device as well as improving our agility since changing the device behavior will just involve SW recompilation.

positions.title: Hardware Architecture Intern
positions.description:
•	Investigate and develop image processing algorithms suitable for HW implementation based on customers' demands for Xscale SoC family.
•	Implemented SystemC models of image processing modules.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed Linux Optimization capability for Intel Xscale Architecture. 
•	Created documentation for Xscale Linux optimization tools. Worked with independent SW vendors to optimize their solution on Xscale platforms.
